authority: Active user Goal; actual global and project AGENTS.md v9; read-only r04_governor CREATE_TASK
objective: Construct and verify a fresh project-private prefix/configuration skeleton and closed filesystem probe harness; deny host Steam/cloud IPC and network; produce evidence for a later runtime-launch decision. Original Goal and A01-A14 unchanged.
protected_boundaries: Game, installed MODs, source archives/downloads, prior MOD workspace, real Steam prefix/saves/backups, Steam userdata/settings/credentials/sessions/cloud and other tasks remain unchanged.
No whole-prefix copy, clone, reflink, writable bind to protected data, save migration, account/session copy, credential lookup, Steam userdata reuse or real-prefix fallback.
No write probes on actual protected paths. Use disposable owned equivalent canaries and inspect actual mount/views.
Host Steam/cloud filesystem/abstract sockets, runtime directories, shared memory and inherited environment references absent or inaccessible.
Network, display/audio/input/GPU and compositor/X11/Wayland endpoints closed.
No third-party binaries/assets/MOD contents/account metadata/private paths/secrets in public files.
All mutation confined to selected repository; private mutation confined to .local/r04.
authorized_effects: Root may create source under src/testing, tests/test_isolation.py, this contract, docs/evidence/R04.json and PROJECT_STATE.json.
Root may construct new private skeleton and disposable CLI probe processes under .local/r04.
No Proton, Steam, game, display, GPU or network launch under v1. A successor contract must freeze any later launch boundary.
After exact review and Governor approval, normal sanitized source commit/push to impl/mod-console and remote verification.

acceptance.C01: Record frozen contract, baseline, ownership, reproducible checks/recovery/evidence and cumulative budget.
acceptance.C02: Only create new owned private root; refuse pre-existing, non-owned, unresolved, overlapping or symlink-escaping targets.
acceptance.C03: Canonical writable root disjoint from protected roots; actual protected host paths absent or read-only; only private owned subtree writable on host.
acceptance.C04: Complete construction manifest: no copied real prefix, saves, Steam userdata/accounts/sessions/cookies, assets or MOD binaries.
acceptance.C05: Disposable write succeeds in owned subtree; protected canary rejects writes; mount/view checks establish actual protected read-only/absent, Steam/cloud IPC/network/device absence.
acceptance.C06: Strip/reject inherited session/compatdata/runtime paths and variables; missing prerequisite refuses with no unisolated fallback.
acceptance.C07: Root reproduces targeted tests and one end-to-end probe; record commands/exits/versions and failures; previous capability-only probe insufficient.
acceptance.C08: Exact current protected save and relevant configuration preimages unchanged, without credential value access/recording.
acceptance.C09: Public evidence sanitized; Proton/game/Steam launch, save/cloud behavior and loader/runtime compatibility explicitly NOT_RUN.
acceptance.C10: PROJECT_STATE.json sole state with stable task ID, pointers, cumulative attempts/failure fingerprint, partial status and one next action.
acceptance.C11: Root registers exact semantic candidate and private-evidence digest excluding decision metadata; fresh read-only Judge PASS followed by Governor decision.
acceptance.C12: No final R04/R05 or A01-A14 completion credit from isolation capabilities.

evidence_plan: Private paths/manifests/raw results/preimages in .local/r04; public aggregate/digests/commands/exit codes in docs/evidence/R04.json. Register exact hashes excluding state and decision metadata.
recovery: Stop exact owned disposable probe on failure; replace/remove only owned candidate material; check concurrent edits before restoring exact tracked preimage; unexpected protected/Steam IPC access stops route; preserve fingerprint and compare preimages without broad rollback.

budget.scope: All discovery/construction/repair/validation/roles/closure cumulative under existing unbudgeted native Goal; no reset.

implementation_adaptive: Paths/APIs/tests/cleanup remain adaptive within frozen dimensions; no speculative orchestration or display/GPU mechanisms.
